Document: Part 89 Attachment of earnings
Part 2 of 2
==================================================
[PART 89 – ATTACHMENT OF EARNINGS > 89.19] (7) If notice of any objection is not given within the time stated, the court officer must make a consolidated attachment order. [PART 89 – ATTACHMENT OF EARNINGS > 89.19] (8) If any party objects to the making of a consolidated attachment order, the court officer must refer the application to the District Judge who may grant the application after considering the objection made and the reasons given. [PART 89 – ATTACHMENT OF EARNINGS > 89.19] (9) A person to whom two or more attachment of earnings orders are directed to secure the payment of judgment debts by the same debtor may request the court in writing to make a consolidated attachment order to secure the payment of those debts. [PART 89 – ATTACHMENT OF EARNINGS > 89.19] (10) On receipt by the court of a request under paragraph (9), paragraphs (1) and (6) to (8) apply, with the necessary modifications, as if the request were an application by the creditor. ## Making of consolidated attachment order by court of its own initiative

## 89.20 Where—

[PART 89 – ATTACHMENT OF EARNINGS > 89.20 Where—] (a) an application is made for an attachment of earnings order to secure the payment of a judgment debt by a debtor in respect of whom an attachment of earnings order is already in force to secure the payment of another judgment debt; and

[PART 89 – ATTACHMENT OF EARNINGS > 89.20 Where—] (b) no application is made for a consolidated attachment order,

[PART 89 – ATTACHMENT OF EARNINGS > 89.20 Where—] the court officer may make such an order of that officer’s own initiative after giving all persons concerned an opportunity of submitting written objections. ## Extension of consolidated attachment order

## 89.21

[PART 89 – ATTACHMENT OF EARNINGS > 89.21] (1) This rule applies where—

[PART 89 – ATTACHMENT OF EARNINGS > 89.21] (a) a consolidated attachment order is in force to secure the payment of two or more judgment debts (“the original debts”); and

[PART 89 – ATTACHMENT OF EARNINGS > 89.21] (b) a further judgment debt (“the additional debt”) is owed by the same debtor. [PART 89 – ATTACHMENT OF EARNINGS > 89.21] (2) The creditor of the additional debt may apply for the consolidated attachment order to be extended so as to secure the payment of the additional debt as well as the original debts. [PART 89 – ATTACHMENT OF EARNINGS > 89.21] (3) If the application to extend the consolidated attachment order is granted, the court may—

[PART 89 – ATTACHMENT OF EARNINGS > 89.21] (a) vary the order accordingly; or

[PART 89 – ATTACHMENT OF EARNINGS > 89.21] (b) discharge the order and make a new consolidated attachment order to secure payment of all the judgment debts. [PART 89 – ATTACHMENT OF EARNINGS > 89.21] (4) An application under this rule must be made to the court that made the consolidated attachment order and is treated for the purposes of rules 89.19 and 89.20 as an application for a consolidated attachment order. ## Payments under consolidated attachment order

## 89.22

[PART 89 – ATTACHMENT OF EARNINGS > 89.22] (1) If a court officer receives payment in compliance with a consolidated attachment order, the court officer must—

[PART 89 – ATTACHMENT OF EARNINGS > 89.22] (a) first deduct any court fees due in respect of proceedings for or arising out of the order that are permitted to be deducted; and

[PART 89 – ATTACHMENT OF EARNINGS > 89.22] (b) then divide the remainder of the payment to satisfy the relevant judgments falling within the ambit of the consolidated attachment order, in proportion with the amounts payable under each judgment. [PART 89 – ATTACHMENT OF EARNINGS > 89.22] (2) For the purpose of satisfying those relevant judgments, dividends may from time to time be declared and distributed among the creditors so entitled.
